record.proseDraft:
No items were recorded as confirmed and no items were recorded as still open. The statements covered rotating staging keys, including the payments sandbox key, the email provider key and two internal service tokens, while production keys were stated to be out of scope.

Stated in the meeting
- It was stated that staging keys the contractor could see would be rotated because that contractor finished last week.
- It was stated that this means the payments sandbox key, the email provider key, and the two internal service tokens.
- It was stated as a request to Mateo to rotate all four by Tuesday November 3rd, 17:00 UTC.
- It was stated in reply that all four would be done by Tuesday the 3rd, 17:00 UTC.
- It was stated that done means the old keys are revoked at the provider, not just replaced, and the CI secrets are updated so the nightly build passes.
- It was stated in acknowledgement that the old keys will be revoked at the provider, CI secrets updated, and the nightly build green.
- It was stated that the provider dashboards will be checked on Wednesday morning to confirm the old keys show as revoked.
- It was stated that progress will be posted in the infra channel as each one is done.
- It was stated that production keys are out of scope.
- It was stated in acknowledgement that it is staging only.
- It was stated that if a rotation breaks something to roll forward and not restore the old key.
- It was stated in acknowledgement that this makes sense because the old ones will be revoked anyway.
